prompt: A hooded specter of wispy dark-grey smoke and tattered black shroud, its lower body unraveling into wisps as it dies, leaning down toward the south-west, one long skeletal arm clamped onto a screaming soldier in dented steel plate armor and dragging him into the same void of nothingness it is dissolving into. A sickly pale-green spectral glow outlines the specter and the curse spreading over the soldier. The background is a moonlit graveyard of crooked tombstones under bruise-purple storm clouds.
